instruction:
GUI-only requirement: Complete the entire task through the launched graphical user interfaces only. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, PowerShell, or any shell. Do not run Python, VBA, macros, Abaqus noGUI, ANSYS command scripts, batch/headless tools, APIs, or helper code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only the native SolidWorks and Abaqus/CAE GUI tools, menus, dialogs, editors, and built-in import, export, save, submit, and solve commands.

Two-software CAE flow: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. No init file is provided; start from a new blank SolidWorks part.

Chain evidence requirement: use the design token EW_SW_ABQ_03. Keep this token encoded in the SolidWorks part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage1_geometry.step contains EW_SW_ABQ_03 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_SW_ABQ_03 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.


1. In SolidWorks, use GUI sketch and feature tools only to create a D120 x 10 mm circular flange cover with a centered D60 recessed pressure face, eight D6 bolt holes on a 90 mm bolt circle, and a small outer chamfer. Export the completed CAD geometry to C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage1_geometry.step through the GUI and create the finite-element model. Use the model name Model-FlangePressure. Define material Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, create a solid section using Steel, and assign it to the flange cover. Create a Static General analysis step named Step-Pressure. Create a set named BOLT_HOLES and a surface named PRESSURE_FACE. Use a coarse first-order linear solid mesh that captures the bolt holes and recessed pressure face without dense bolt-hole refinement; use C3D8R where practical or coarse C3D4 where needed, and do not use quadratic elements. Create a boundary condition named BC-BoltHoles that constrains BOLT_HOLES. Create a pressure load named Pressure-1p5MPa with magnitude approximately 1.5 MPa on PRESSURE_FACE. Submit the job named Job-FlangePressure and wait for the analysis to complete.
3. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-FlangePressure.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-FlangePressure.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

[Software] Open and use SolidWorks and Abaqus/CAE one at a time through the Windows GUI as needed. First use SolidWorks to create and export the CAD STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables.
